periods.name: 变装与声音模仿
periods.summary: A high-level disguise art associated with Riko/Robin IV and adopted by Jeanne. Jeanne impersonates Shirayuki for days inside Tokyo Butei High, imitates Kinji's voice by phone to manipulate Shirayuki, and uses the disguise to ambush Aria. In the cliffhanger Riko impersonates Aria to enter Hysteria Mode-triggering proximity with Kinji.

evidence.quote: Jeanne used Kinji's voice by phone to manipulate Shirayuki.
Kinji only sees through fake Shirayuki thanks to Hysteria Mode.
Jeanne had been disguised as Shirayuki in school.
Jeanne says Riko/Robin IV taught her the difficult disguise.
